props.name: scopes
props.description: The scopes on offer. The first one is the catch-all when it is called `all`.

props.name: onScopeChange
props.description: Called when the scope changes — from the selector or from an `in:` token.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every keystroke with the query text.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Candidate results. They are filtered by scope and by a case-insensitive match on the label.

props.name: filterSuggestions
props.description: Set false when the suggestions are already filtered by a server. Scope is still applied.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the query and scope when Enter is pressed without a suggestion highlighted.

props.name: onSuggestionSelect
props.description: Called when a suggestion is chosen.

props.name: recognizeTokens
props.description: Recognise a typed `in:docs ` and turn it into the scope.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the search field.
